t: An open hardware Linux board with a built-in AI accelerator.
steps: Buy the board from Newark, DigiKey, or Seeed Studio. It launched at about 70 US dollars, and store prices now run from 99.90 to 239 US dollars.
Get a microSD card and a 5 volt USB-C power supply with Power Delivery.
Write the Debian image to the microSD card with an image writing app.
Insert the card and connect power, a screen, and a keyboard.
Follow the BeagleY-AI quick start guide on the BeagleBoard docs site.
Blink an LED with the GPIO tutorial.
Add an IMX219 camera and run the object detection demo.
meta: Open Board. From $99.90. A few stores.
